facts.business: BGR Energy Systems Limited is an engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) company executing projects in thermal power, nuclear power, and electrical infrastructure sectors, including Balance of Plant (BoP) packages.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Unit III of Ghatampur thermal power project scheduled to be completed in the 1st Qtr of financial year 2026-27
Balance works on Coal handling plant and Railway marshalling yard for NTTPS project poised for completion by Sep 26
NPCIL Kudankulam Electrical package job slated for completion in Sept 2026
NPCIL Kudankulam C&I package balance items scheduled to be delivered by 31.03.2027

auditor.name: A N P & Associates (A&PCA)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) NUPPL Ghatampur contract claims of Rs 1,62,042 lakhs with Rs 33,969 lakhs recommended by Conciliation Committee, costs of Rs 23,455 lakhs (year) and Rs 39,583 lakhs (cumulative) charged to P&L pending approval; 2) NTTPS Vijayawada contract claims of Rs 76,980 lakhs pending customer approval, costs of Rs 3,307 lakhs charged to P&L; 3) Nine PSBs assigned dues to NARCL on 29 Sep 2025, ICICI Bank facilities remain NPA, Axis Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank facilities non-fund based and not NPA; interest of Rs 16,276 lakhs (up to June 2025) and Rs 53,220 lakhs (up to March 2026) provided. Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern disclosed but opinion not modified.

key_risks: Prolonged liquidity constraints from borrowings classified as NPAs by lending consortium
Limited working capital affecting project execution, procurement, and manpower mobilization
Slowdown in project execution with increased input costs and supply chain challenges
Delays in customer payments impacting billing milestones and revenue recognition
Material uncertainty related to going concern due to unresolved debt settlement with NARCL
Significant claims pending customer approval (Ghatampur Rs 1,62,042 lakhs, NTTPS Rs 76,980 lakhs) with related costs already charged to P&L
Dependence on completion of legacy projects with no new BoP orders being accepted
